notes:
v4.6.110 — Smooth refresh + closed-trades controls

✨ Charts now update in place instead of blanking and reappearing on every refresh. The data is morphed live (Plotly react), so prices and equity curves tick smoothly with no flash and no page jumping around — and the numbers update as fast as the data arrives.

📜 The 'Closed trades' panel (bottom-right of each bot page) now scrolls through your FULL closed-trade history instead of just the latest few.

🙈 New 'Show P/L' toggle on the Positions & Closed Trades section: hide or show realised (closed) and unrealised (open) gains with one click — handy for screenshots or a quick glance without the dollar figures.

🛟 Also includes the take-profit protection fix: bots run on both Alpaca and IBKR no longer share one state file, so tracked stop/take-profit brackets can't be wiped and a position won't slip past its target unsold (win/loss counts are accurate again).

Update via the in-app banner.
